reuse.why: Reuses getApproxNumberThreshold for the tolerance and makes the existing getScheduledAmount delegate, but adds a parallel exported getWorstCaseAmount (plus a single-use exported getRangeAmount) instead of routing the copies through the existing helper.

duplication.why: The five inline midpoint/missing/number dispatches (app.ts x2, forecast, schedule-template, preview) are all replaced by one definition.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts next to getScheduledAmount; the API model only calls it.

scope.why: Focused on the rule and the API field, though the step-1 and step-3 release notes still describe the superseded 'furthest from zero' rule.

maintainability.why: One rule definition is easy to own; having two public names for nearly the same thing and an optional op that callers can silently omit is a mild hazard.

abstraction_drift.where: getScheduledAmount gained an optional op parameter (shared/schedules.ts); the isapprox branch in getWorstCaseAmount is the rule itself, and every amount site routes through the shared definition.
